newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian palm olein prices stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian palm olein prices stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein and crude palm oil (CPO) prices were little changed in late trading on Monday, traders said.
"We see some prices for CPO. But I don't think sellers are really serious. They just want to test the market with small amounts," one trader in Medan said.
He said players were waiting for the rupiah to stabilise before they started trading again.
Other traders said they were also waiting for tenders to give price direction after the fall of the rupiah against the dollar last week.
However, the rupiah was recovering from steep fall, rising to close at 2,585/95 in Jakarta on Monday, compared with a historic low of 2,665 last Monday.
CPO prices were quoted at 1,170 rupiah/kg in Medan, compared with 1,200 rupiah on Friday. Olein was little changed at 1,410/15 rupiah/kg in Jakarta.
